display_long_description:
BraceUp VR is the ultimate Play & Train game combining arcade fun with home fitness! Compete with friends in break activities and get your heart pumping.

Master Break Modes
Jump into four action-packed mini-games: hit targets in Archery, throw Snowballs, deflect Shurikens with a Katana, or aim true with a Revolver. Each mode brings a fresh twist to your workout!

Boost with Exercises
Gain an edge by performing real-world moves: Splashing Water, Running, Jumping Jacks, Boxing, Squat Jumps, and Wide Squats. Better performance gives you an upper hand in-game.

Explore Immersive Worlds
Train in the Castle, chill on the Island, focus in the Dojo, or duel in the Western. Each has unique visuals and obstacles.

Online PvP Madness
Battle friends and global players in thrilling multiplayer duels. Will you reach the top?

Solo Adventure Mode
No internet? No problem. Conquer challenges and prove you're the hero in offline play.

Customize Your Challenge
Choose Easy, Medium, Hard, or Hero mode. Set your own intensity with adjustable reps and time.

Key Features:
• 4 Worlds: Castle, Island, Dojo, Western
• 4 Break Modes: Archery, Snowballs, Katana, Revolver
• 6 Exercises: Full-body movements
• Custom Difficulty
• Cross-platform: Steam & Meta Quest
